name: SolidWorks previews, outline-first Parasolid assemblies and a sharper review kit
summary: The 2.69 releases widen what you can open and make a review easier to read. Every feature shown below runs inside the one file you download.

highlights.title: See inside SolidWorks files
highlights.text: Open a .sldprt or .sldasm to view the display preview saved inside it. Assembly parts are placed when their files are opened with it, and anything unresolved is listed. Older legacy-format files are not previewed.

highlights.title: Parasolid assemblies, outline first
highlights.text: A text Parasolid (.x_t) assembly shows its structure and outline first, then fills in detail starting with what the camera is looking at. Finished views are cached for the next time you open it.

highlights.title: Inspect NX and JT structure
highlights.text: Look inside a Siemens NX .prt or a JT 9 file: its streams, references and embedded documents. Structure only; the geometry is not decoded.

highlights.title: Six studio looks for renders
highlights.text: Choose a preset such as Neutral engineering, Polished product or Blueprint illustration to set quality, tone mapping, backdrop and floor in one click. Your part materials stay as they are.

highlights.title: Callouts and 3D notes that stay put
highlights.text: Drag measurement callouts to where they read best. 3D notes stay anchored to the part when the view changes, and inspection summaries export as CSV or Markdown.

highlights.title: Isolate a single PMI callout
highlights.text: In the PMI review of a STEP AP242 file, isolate any graphical annotation so it is shown on its own, with a label that states how it is linked to the source.

notes: v2.69.1 is a SolidWorks compatibility repair for the optional local native-viewing route. That route runs on Windows through a separately installed helper and a separately licensed converter; neither is part of this download.

SolidWorks previews come from the display data saved inside the file. Units are unverified, exact B-rep and PMI are not decoded, and an assembly needs its component files opened together with it. Missing or unresolved components are listed, not hidden. Older files in the legacy compound-file container are not previewed.
Siemens NX (.prt) and JT 9 support is structure inspection only: containers, streams, references and embedded JT documents. NX and JT geometry is not decoded in the browser.
Text Parasolid (.x_t) opens as a visual model for viewing. Binary Parasolid (.x_b) and exact Parasolid topology need a qualified external provider.
Studio presets change presentation only: quality, tone mapping, backdrop and floor. They do not change part materials.
Coordinates of unknown unit are shown as model units. No millimetre or inch value is invented.
The inspection table copied from the Measure panel as CSV neutralises text that a spreadsheet could read as a formula.
